title: Being unable to open Customers does not stop a user from picking a customer when creating a work order
preconds:
1. A custom role 'WO Creator No Cust' has Work orders View and Create & Edit on but Customers View off.
  2. A user is assigned that role.
steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Try to open Customers.
  3. Open Work Orders and start creating a work order.
  4. Use the customer picker on the form.
  5. Select an existing customer.
  6. Save.
expected:
Customers cannot be opened (hidden or refused).

The create work order flow works.

The customer picker still works and an existing customer can be selected and the work order saved — feature access (opening the Customers page) is separate from data access (using customers where needed).
